prose: OpenAI is developing features to counter SpaceX's Grok Bot 'teammates' and has discussed building a personal AI assistant to compete with Meta's Muse, The Information reports. The outlet notes OpenAI pioneered AI that can operate web browsers and other applications on a user's behalf, while ChatGPT brought generative AI to consumers.
highlights: OpenAI is working on features to counter SpaceX's Grok Bot 'teammates', per sources.
It has discussed a personal AI assistant to compete with Meta's Muse.
The reporting comes as agent-style assistants proliferate across rivals.
